prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `FieldOrientation`, `FieldDescriptor`, `FieldPresentation`, and `makeFieldPresentation`. `FieldOrientation` is the union `"row" | "column"`. A descriptor contains `label`, `name`, `value`, optional `orientation`, optional `kind`, optional readonly `issues`, and optional `extraClass`. The function returns normalized data with orientation defaulting to `column`, kind defaulting to `text`, `inputClass` beginning with exactly `field-input`, and a copied `issues` array. A nonblank `extraClass` is trimmed and appended after one space; it must extend rather than replace the base class. Preserve label, name, and value exactly. Blank names, invalid orientations, non-array issues, or non-string issue entries must throw `TypeError`. Undefined issues become an empty array. The input and its issues array must not be mutated or retained.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
